title: Emergency hotlines
description: Numbers shown on the Emergency Hotlines page, in the scrolling hotline bar above the navbar, and counted on the home page. See src/Data/Site/README.md.

lastUpdated.description: When the numbers were last checked, as YYYY-MM-DD. For your records; not shown on the site.

updatedBy.description: Who last checked the numbers. For your records; not shown on the site.

number.description: Phone number as people should read it, e.g. "0998 598 7104". Spaces are removed automatically for the tap-to-call link.

category.description: Group on the Emergency Hotlines page: "emergency" (police, fire, rescue), "hospital", "towing", "utility" (power, water) or "government" (city offices). Numbers without one are listed under "Other numbers".

description.description: Optional short note shown under the number on the Emergency Hotlines page, e.g. "24/7" or "Panabo City Police Station".

hidden.description: Not shown anywhere. Handy for a number that's temporarily out of service.
